name: MonarchMentionPicker
title: MentionPicker
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of MonarchListRow rows, with MonarchAvatar, MonarchSkeleton and MonarchInlineErrorRetry; androidx.compose.ui.text.input.TextFieldValue for the caret
summary: Suggestions for an @mention or #channel: a strip of people and channels above the message field and the keyboard, with loading, empty and error states, and helpers that find the mention being typed and replace it.
whenToUse: In a message or comment composer where people mention others with @ or channels with #.
whenNotToUse: Not for general search suggestions; use a Material 3 SearchBar with its suggestion list. Not for choosing people in a form; use a list with checkboxes or a dropdown menu.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchMentionPicker(query: MonarchMentionQuery?, items: List<MonarchMentionItem>, onSelect: (MonarchMentionItem) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, status: MonarchMentionPickerStatus = MonarchMentionPickerStatus.Ready, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchMentionPickerLabels = MonarchMentionPickerLabels())

public class MonarchMentionQuery(trigger: Char, text: String, start: Int, end: Int) { fun replacing(text: String, replacement: String): String; fun replacing(value: TextFieldValue, replacement: String): TextFieldValue; companion object { fun find(text: String, caret: Int = text.length, triggers: Set<Char> = setOf('@')): MonarchMentionQuery?; fun find(value: TextFieldValue, triggers: Set<Char> = setOf('@')): MonarchMentionQuery? } }

public class MonarchMentionItem(id: String, label: String, kind: MonarchMentionKind = MonarchMentionKind.Person, detail: String? = null, image: Painter? = null, enabled: Boolean = true) { fun token(trigger: Char = '@'): String }
public enum class MonarchMentionKind { Person, Channel }
public enum class MonarchMentionPickerStatus { Loading, Ready, Failed }

public class MonarchMentionPickerLabels(label: String? = null, people: String? = null, channels: String? = null, loading: String? = null, empty: String? = null, error: String? = null, retry: String? = null, count: ((Int) -> String)? = null)

options.name: query
options.description: The mention being typed, from MonarchMentionQuery.find; null closes the picker.

options.name: items
options.description: The suggestions from the app's search. People and channels are grouped under headings when both are present; more than about four scroll.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Called with the chosen suggestion. Complete the mention with query.replacing(value, item.token(query.trigger) + " ").

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the strip. Place it directly above the message field.

options.name: status
options.description: Loading shows placeholder rows, Failed the error.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Repeats a failed search: adds a Retry button.

states.name: loading
states.description: Three placeholder rows, one element read as "Searching…".

states.name: results
states.description: A row per suggestion with an avatar, or a square number-sign tile for a channel; people and channels under headings when both are present.

states.name: disabled suggestion
states.description: Text in the disabled color; the row cannot be chosen.

states.name: no matches
states.description: "No matches". When a query with a space finds nothing, the picker closes.

states.name: failed
states.description: "Couldn’t load suggestions." with a Retry button when onRetry is given.

appearance: A strip on the surface color with a subtle top border; labels in the default text color, details, headings and notes in the muted text color, disabled rows in the disabled text color; avatars with their fallback colors and a square number-sign tile for channels. The same roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The web anchors a listbox to the caret with aria-activedescendant and arrow keys, and ships hooks that debounce and abort the search. Compose gives no caret rectangle, so on Android, as on iOS, the picker is a full-width strip that the app places directly above the message field, so it sits above the keyboard with the field's imePadding; suggestions are buttons. The app runs its search in a LaunchedEffect keyed by the query, which cancels the previous one; Monarch adds no debounce timer. MonarchMentionQuery.find reads the caret from TextFieldValue.selection, so a mention in the middle of the text is found. The token format matches the web's formatMentionToken; the web's parseMentionTokens and getCaretRect have no Android counterpart in this release.
accessibility: The strip is a group named "Suggestions" and a polite live region whose state is the result count, "Searching…", "No matches" or the error, so the change is announced while focus stays in the text field.
Each suggestion is a button whose name is its label and detail; a disabled suggestion is marked disabled and cannot be activated.
Avatars and the channel tile are decorative.
Rows are at least 56dp high and grow with the font size setting; long details wrap.
edgeCases: A trigger inside a word, such as in an email address, finds no query.
A query ends after two words, a line break or a word longer than 40 characters.
Replacing a query removes one space after it when the replacement ends with a space, so a mention typed mid-sentence does not leave two spaces.
A query's range belongs to the text it was found in; replacing in a shorter text leaves it unchanged.
While a range of text is selected, find on a TextFieldValue returns null.
